title: Storage Analyzer: Big Files
short_description: Find large files, duplicates and old junk, then clear space safely.

guides.title: How to Find Duplicate Files on Android
guides.description: How to find exact duplicate files on an Android phone, how checksums prove two files are the same, and which copy to keep when you delete.

guides.title: How to Find Old Unused Files on Android
guides.description: Find files you have not changed for more than 90 days: old downloads, screenshots, WhatsApp media and APK installers. See the rules and a worked example.

guides.title: MB to GB Conversion Chart for Phone Storage
guides.description: Convert MB to GB and back with a chart and a calculator. Learn why a 128 GB phone shows less space, with worked examples for GB and GiB.
